decision: Music = user-uploaded Macarena (slowed+reverb) mp3, only the opening used; grid 75.34 BPM (beat 0.7964 s), main drop at 13.874 s of the track
why: User supplied the track mid-session and asked to use only the beginning and cut on drops; bass energy jumps +20 dB at 13.874 s (spectrogram + low-pass RMS per grid point), kicks then land every 0.7964 s

decision: Drive 'Honda FG2 F1..R3.jpg' (96ronald) are NOT finished IRL photos - they are 13854x9167 scan-product renders (solid scan, x-ray overlay, exploded parts); used only as scan-look reference
why: Looked at the contact sheet: every image is a teal/green/purple scan render with illumaesthetic + 3D logos; IRL finished photos must come from epsilon.plus or Dropbox

decision: Angle A (front-on.jpg, #806 front 3/4) solved: 7 landmarks (wheel hubs, headlight, grille, windshield) then silhouette refinement vs GrabCut mask; f=21.1 mm-equiv, chamfer 2.0/2.5 px @700w
why: Landmark-only solve stalled at ~15 px because the race car's bumper/lip/ride differ from the stock-state scan; silhouette fit + onion check shows emblem, headlight, hood line and wheel overlapping

decision: Angles = P1 race-car-front-quarter, P2 red-race-car, D motorsport-front-quarter, E rear-quarter; dropped front-on.jpg (A) and red-front-view.jpg (B)
why: User: avoid photos where the lip is still black/unpainted; A and B show the black lip, P1/P2 show the painted red lip, D a painted white lip, E doesn't show the lip

decision: CGI lip keeps Ecky's red Material.003 (undo the black-lip override); sky hidden from camera rays only
why: Photos now show the painted red lip, so Ecky's red lip matches; black background matches his CGI->real reference while his sky still lights the car

decision: Angle P1 (race-car-front-quarter.jpg) solved: 8 landmarks + silhouette refinement (scan+lip mesh), shadow/wing/aftermarket-mirror zones ignored; f=28.2 mm-equiv, chamfer 2.7/1.9 px @700w
why: Onion check: emblem, headlight, hood lines, both wheels and roofline coincide; first pass without ignore zones was pulled ~30 px down by the car's shadow

decision: Angle P2 (red-race-car.jpg, low front 3/4) solved: 8 landmarks + silhouette refinement; f=67.4 mm-equiv (tele shot), chamfer 2.4/2.2 px @700w
why: Onion: emblem, both headlights, hood, both wheels coincide; scan's tyres sit ~2 cm lower than the lowered race car, body is the match reference

decision: Angle D (motorsport-front-quarter.jpg, side 3/4) solved: 6 landmarks + silhouette refinement; f=41.3 mm-equiv, chamfer 4.6/4.1 px @700w
why: Onion: mirror, both wheels, door line and roof coincide; front bumper edge within ~1% (white lip extends further than the CAD lip)

decision: TikTok framing: every photo/CGI/scan layer shares one 9:16 crop window per angle (full-bleed, no letterbox); hero (lip/wing) kept above the bottom ~20% and left of the right ~12% UI column
why: User asked for TikTok format; TikTok overlays caption at the bottom and action buttons on the right

decision: Angle E (red-race-car-rear-quarter.jpg) solved: coarse silhouette grid search (landmark solve put the camera inside the trunk) + refinement, wing/shadow ignored; f=26.1 mm-equiv, chamfer 3.6/4.2 px @700w
why: Only 5 rear landmarks shared with the stock-state scan; onion check shows rear emblem, taillight, plate recess, rear wheel and mirror coincide

decision: CGI for E adds engineering's 'GT wing FG2.stl' (already in the scan frame) in black satin to Ecky's lip scene
why: Neither of Ecky's .blends has the GT wing that is on the real car; without it the CGI->real cut on the rear angle would not read as the same car

decision: Timeline: P1 hook real(2b)->scan(2b)->CGI(2b)->real(2b) before the drop; after the drop P2, D, E each scan(1b)->CGI(1b)->real(2b); finale P1b scan->CGI->real; logo card 2 beats; 20.7 s
why: Hook = first 1:1 transformation at 1.6 s; user asked to cut on drops so the angle changes sit on the drop and every following kick; each angle ends on the real car so the viewer reads scan->design->finished product

decision: Stills as video: one shared Ken Burns window per angle (photo, CGI, scan), 8-17% push, sub-shots take consecutive 'in' points from the same push
why: A 2D push applied identically to all three layers keeps the car pixel-locked across every cut while it moves; far cheaper than 3D camera moves (one Blender still per layer)

decision: Clip durs set in whole frames so each cut = round(beat*30); first clip 1 frame short
why: Beat-length durs drifted +40..+119 ms (frame rounding + the assembler's cut hold frame); now all 16 cuts within +-17 ms

decision: End card = official IllumaestheticLogoColor-01.png on black (Drive), hard cut on the downbeat at 19.10 s
why: No approved card exists for this project in Drive; the 240SX card lives in a Dropbox video and Dropbox hosts need network approval

decision: E CGI wing gets two 8 mm black plate uprights at the real upright positions (raycast from the photo onto the trunk)
why: 'GT wing FG2.stl' is blade + endplates only; it floated in the render. Uprights are stand-ins, not engineering geometry - flagged in review
Every frame is either a real photo (never text over IRL) or a full-frame render; TikTok captions carry the copy, and there was no verified number worth putting on screen
